Results.ReviewText: I am very happy with the grill. I have been cooking with it all summer and have had excellent results and many complements on the food.  I love having the gas tank on the outside of the grill so that I can turn it off when I finish grilling without burning my hands by touching the bottom of the grill.  Just a couple of small design areas that need to be improved in future versions. 1 - when I open the grill to turn my food, smoke seems to aim directly into my face.  I haven’t experienced this with former gas grills.  And 2 - having wheels just on one side of the grill makes it a bit awkward to move the grill around from the wall to the the open part of the deck.  My last grill had wheels on all four legs which made it a breeze to move the grill back and forth on the deck.
Results.Title: Excellent grill

We appreciate your feedback and we are sorry to hear that we let you down. For the best results with your regulator, and for safety reasons, we recommend always turning off the gas at the tank connection after you are done grilling. 
If there is anything else we can do to help in the future, please let us know. Thanks again for your feedback and for being a Weber fan!

45010001.Description:
Get ready to step up your grilling experience. As the family sits down for dinner, or a couple of friends come over for a bite – this three burner grill will do its magic. With the spacious cooking area you can sear steaks on one side while grilling an appetizer on the other, and the convenient open-cart allows you to keep your tools and equipment within reach. Armed with the strong GS4 grilling system, this gas grill is sure to take you and your meals to the next level.


 This product requires assembly.
